title: ATS account and sign-in settings
source_system: Recruiting ATS/CRM admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: One user, the owner's administrator account; password sign-in; MFA is available and turned off; a password reset link is sent to the owner's business email address; the email sync add-on connects the ATS to the mailbox

title: ATS candidate, job order and client record report
source_system: Recruiting ATS/CRM reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About 3,400 candidate records (names, home addresses, phone numbers, resumes, compensation notes), the oldest created in 2019 and about 1,200 created in 2025; some records have ID image attachments; no retention or automatic deletion rule is set; about 40 job orders opened in the last 12 months, all for IT support, accounting and data analyst roles with Florida clients; about 15 active client company records, each listing 50 to 500 employees

title: ATS activity log and data export page
source_system: Recruiting ATS/CRM admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: The activity log records sign-ins, exports and downloads and can be filtered by date; the data export page lists no previous full export of candidates or job orders

title: ATS vendor trust page and subscription terms
source_system: ATS vendor website
what_it_shows: The trust page states that the vendor holds a SOC 2 Type 2 report, available on request, and backs up customer data daily; the subscription terms delete customer data 30 days after the subscription ends; no SOC 2 report from the vendor is on file

title: AI match add-on settings and disposition history
source_system: ATS AI match add-on settings and disposition log (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Add-on turned on 2026-02-02; each applicant is scored 0-100 against the job order and the list is sorted by score; automatic rejection (auto-disposition) below a score of 40 is set on for two job orders, a staff accountant and a help desk analyst; the disposition log lists 412 applicants to those job orders from 2026-04-06 to 2026-06-26, of whom 236 received an automatic rejection email with no reviewer recorded; the setting that opts out of vendor use of customer data to improve its models is off (the default)

title: AI match add-on terms and help documentation
source_system: ATS vendor website and help center
what_it_shows: The add-on terms allow the vendor to use customer data to improve its models unless the customer turns on the opt-out setting; the help documentation names skills, job titles, years of experience, education, location and "employment gaps" as scoring inputs and publishes no feature weights

title: Active job ads and sourcing accounts
source_system: Professional networking site recruiter account; two job board accounts (SYS-09)
what_it_shows: Active job ads on the two job boards and the networking site; applications flow into the ATS; the ads do not say that software sorts applications and give no contact for an accommodation or a review by a person; the job ads link to the business's one-page website, and the business has a profile on the networking site

title: Email and file account security and plan settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Business plan with one user, the owner; second factor is an SMS text code to the owner's phone, the only registered method; no recovery codes generated; the provider keeps a sign-in history and records mailbox rule changes; security notices from the provider go to the owner's email and phone; the optional new-sign-in alert is off; file version history is kept 30 days (plan default)

title: Mailbox and file storage content review
source_system: Productivity suite mailbox and file storage (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: The mailbox holds resumes and client submittals; about 70 messages from 2019 to 2025 carry contractor start forms with full SSNs and dates of birth; candidates' messages include ID images; two background check reports forwarded by two clients (received 2025-11 and 2026-03) are in the inbox; the sent folder shows start forms sent to the partner as email attachments

title: Email and file provider plan documentation
source_system: Productivity suite provider help center and security page
what_it_shows: The business plan keeps 30 days of file versions and deleted items; the provider describes platform backups, encryption of stored data and TLS in transit, and attachment scanning

title: E-signature account settings
source_system: E-signature service account settings (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: Sign-in goes through the business email account (federated sign-in, so the email second factor applies); the account holds client fee agreements and candidate consent-to-represent forms

title: Partner portal account and sign-in settings
source_system: Back-office partner portal (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: One recruiter login; sign-in is a password plus a one-time code sent to the owner's business email; the start request form takes the contractor's name, address, SSN, date of birth, pay and bill rates and start date, and masks the SSN after submission; the portal shows each contractor's background check only as "cleared to start" or "not cleared"; clients approve timesheets in the portal; monthly margin statements are posted there

title: Back-office services agreement
source_system: Signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: The partner is the employer of record for contractors: it completes Forms I-9, runs E-Verify, orders background checks under its own FCRA certification, withholds taxes, pays wages, provides benefits and workers' compensation, and invoices clients for contract hours; the recruiter is paid a share of contract gross margin monthly; the agreement has a general confidentiality clause and no security requirements or breach notice clause

title: Partner monthly margin statements, 2025-01 to 2026-06
source_system: Back-office partner portal (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: About 24 different contractors paid through the partner in 2025; 11 contractors on assignment at 6 client companies in June 2026; the recruiter's margin share is about $9,750 a month, paid by ACH

title: Accounting SaaS user list, security settings and 2025 income report
source_system: Accounting SaaS (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Two named accounts, the owner and the outside bookkeeper; the vendor enforces MFA on both; 2025 income of about $117,000 in partner margin deposits and about $63,000 in direct-hire fees from 5 placements (average fee about $12,500, 20% of first-year salary), paid by ACH or check; no card payments

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship of the owner-recruiter with no employees; principal business code 561320

title: Bank and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-07-12
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the ATS vendor, the productivity suite, the accounting SaaS, the e-signature service, the networking site recruiter subscription, two job boards, the phone carrier, the internet provider, and the professional liability insurer; monthly payments to the outside bookkeeper; hourly payments to the local IT shop; no payment for a standalone cyber insurance policy, a password manager, a security course, a background screening company, or an AI chatbot

title: Client fee agreements
source_system: E-signature service and signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: Fee agreements with about 15 active Florida client companies: contingency fee of 20% of first-year salary for direct hires, who become the client's own employees; a confidentiality clause covering client information; notice of a security incident affecting client information is due "promptly", with no fixed number of hours

title: Contractor agreements and IT support invoices
source_system: Signed agreements folder; email inbox (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: The outside bookkeeper's engagement letter covers about 3 hours a month in the accounting SaaS and has a confidentiality clause; the on-call IT support technician (local IT shop) signed a confidentiality agreement on 2026-07-17; the IT shop's invoices show hourly help with the laptop, phone and router, with remote sessions started by the owner through a one-time session code

title: Laptop settings review
source_system: Laptop settings screens and browser settings (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Business-owned laptop, about 3 years old; full-disk encryption on (operating system default); automatic updates on and update history current; built-in antivirus on with real-time protection and automatic updates; host firewall on; screen locks after 5 minutes; installed software comes from the official store and vendor sites, with no unattended remote-access tool; the downloads folder holds contractor start forms and resumes; passwords for business accounts are saved in the browser and no password manager is installed; the browser's password check flags the ATS password as also used on an old job board account

title: Phone settings and content review
source_system: Smartphone settings screens (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Personal phone, about 2 years old, used for business; passcode and biometric unlock; device encryption on; locks after 30 seconds; automatic updates on; device locator on, with no remote erase ever run or tested; email and ATS apps stay signed in; texts with candidates in the messaging app; the camera roll holds photos of candidate ID documents; the phone receives the email SMS codes

title: Phone carrier order history
source_system: Phone carrier account portal
what_it_shows: The previous phone was traded in through the carrier in 2024; no wipe confirmation is kept

title: Home router admin page and connected devices
source_system: Home router admin page (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Consumer router supplied by the internet provider; one network; the connected-device list shows the work laptop and phone with family phones, a game console and smart-home devices; inbound connections blocked by default; the page shows a firmware version and no update history

title: Home office walk-through
source_system: Home office in the owner's residence (observation)
what_it_shows: Home office in the owner's residence in Central Florida; current fee agreements on paper in a locked drawer; a cross-cut shredder for paper; a surge protector in use; the laptop and phone go with the owner to client offices; candidates are met by video call or in public places

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; file storage; email; paper files
what_it_shows: No written security policy, risk assessment, account or device list, vendor list, incident plan or contact list, continuity plan, retention schedule, disposal procedure, or review of the AI match add-on was found; no security training certificate was found; the 2019 business plan has one page on computer use

title: Professional liability (errors and omissions) policy declarations
source_system: Insurance agent portal
what_it_shows: Professional liability coverage in force for 2026; no cyber endorsement is listed on the declarations page; the full policy form was requested from the agent

title: Consumer AI chatbot account settings and history
source_system: Consumer AI chatbot account (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: Free consumer account used since 2025-11 for job ads and outreach messages; the chat history lists about 30 conversations in which resumes were pasted to draft client summaries; chat history and the model-training setting are on; the consumer terms allow the vendor to use chats to train its models

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner-recruiter's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT support technician
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the owner is the only person who performs each function and holds the client and candidate relationships; contractors keep being paid without the owner because clients approve timesheets in the partner portal; personal savings cover about two months of expenses

title: Risk walk-through of accounts, devices and the home network
source_system: Walk-through of the mailbox, ATS, partner portal, laptop, phone and router with the IT support technician
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: Where personal information sits day to day (mailbox, ATS, laptop downloads folder, phone camera roll, partner portal); the ATS password reset and the partner portal code both go to the mailbox; the email second factor and the ATS app are on the one phone; the laptop travels to client offices; the home office and most clients and contractors are in the same region of Florida; the business keeps no incident log

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-recruiter's written answers to the CSF 2.0 and Fla. Stat. 501.171 questions, checked on screen with the IT support technician
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: Security practices are informal and not written down; stakeholders' security expectations were never written; vendors were chosen on price and features with click-through terms and are not monitored; no threat information is received; suspicious emails are deleted without a second look; no security metrics; the IT support technician has not been asked to help with incidents; the owner did not know the 501.171 notice deadlines or the 500 and 1,000 thresholds; the 2024 phone trade-in followed a factory reset that was not recorded; no restore has been tried; email and ATS log retention periods were not known

title: First account list
source_system: Owner-recruiter's account list, built with the IT support technician
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: Accounts in the ATS, email and files, partner portal, accounting SaaS (owner and bookkeeper), e-signature, networking site, two job boards in use, and the chatbot; recruiter accounts on two other job boards, unused since 2021, are still open and hold old applications; the bookkeeper's accounting account was set up by the owner after a video call; each account belongs to one person; browser-saved passwords sync to the owner's personal browser account, with no primary password

title: Call with the partner's payroll desk
source_system: Phone call with the back-office partner's payroll desk (owner's call notes)
what_it_shows: The payroll desk accepts a contractor's bank-change form forwarded from the owner's email address without calling the contractor; contractors can also change their own bank account in the partner's employee self-service, which uses MFA

title: Partner SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Back-office partner (provided under a nondisclosure agreement)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Confidentiality categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, unqualified opinion; the cloud hosting provider, the background screening vendor and the payroll tax filing provider are carved-out subservice organizations; one exception (2 of 25 sampled terminated partner employees kept portal access for more than 5 business days), remediated; portal MFA options are email or authenticator-app codes; self-service bank changes require employee MFA; changes received by the payroll desk are not in scope; the system description states a 99.5% monthly availability target and no recovery time, and says affected customers are notified of security incidents; complementary user entity controls listed

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment records 15 threat events with sources and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2, includes harm to candidates and contractors, and is documented; the owner is the only decision-maker; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Account security pages; sign-ins from a new browser to email, the ATS, the partner portal and accounting
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: Every owner account is an administrator account; accounting required the vendor's MFA; email accepted an SMS code; the partner portal sent its one-time code to the email account; the ATS signed in with a password only

title: Control assessment: Password and default credential test
source_system: Browser password store; ATS and job board accounts; router admin page; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: The ATS password is reused from an old job board account; the email second factor is an SMS code; passwords are saved in the browser with no primary password and sync to a personal browser account; no written procedure for a lost phone or a compromised password and no recovery codes stored; the home router admin password was still the factory default and the IT technician changed it during the test; accounts are self-service at each vendor and no group or role accounts exist; disk encryption and the phone's keystore protect stored credentials

title: Control assessment: Phone review
source_system: Phone settings; camera roll review
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: No required settings or written guidance for business use of the phone; 9 photos of candidate IDs in the camera roll, deleted the same day; remote erase never tested; the phone reaches business systems only through vendor apps and browsers over TLS; the owner's phone is the only mobile device connected

title: Control assessment: Mailbox and device search
source_system: Search of the mailbox (including sent items), file storage, laptop and phone camera roll; ATS record counts
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: 71 messages with full SSNs and dates of birth for 58 contractors (start forms, 2019-2025); 23 ID images from 19 candidates; the 2 client-forwarded background check reports; 77 people in all with an SSN or a government ID number in the mailbox, 66 living in Florida and 11 in 6 other states; 34 of the start forms also in the laptop downloads folder; 4 start forms sent to the partner by email in 2025-2026; 9 candidate ID photos in the phone camera roll; ATS records since 2019 and ATS exports and downloads kept with no schedule

title: Control assessment: Media disposal review
source_system: Shredder; mailbox search; owner self-review of past device disposals
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: Paper is cross-cut shredded; the 2 consumer reports are still in the mailbox and there is no disposal step for consumer information in electronic form; the previous phone was traded in during 2024 after a factory reset that was not recorded or verified; no device has been reused or handed on inside the business; no sanitization method is defined for electronic media

title: Control assessment: Vendor terms review
source_system: Partner agreement; call with the partner's payroll desk; partner SOC 2 report; ATS, add-on and chatbot terms
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: The partner agreement has a confidentiality clause only; the AI match add-on and consumer chatbot terms allow training on candidate data; no vendor list or oversight steps are documented; the partner's payroll desk accepts bank-change forms forwarded from the owner's email without a call-back; partner portal roles and the bookkeeper's accounting role are defined; the partner's SOC 2 report was reviewed for the first time on 2026-07-23; the ATS vendor's report has never been requested

title: Control assessment: Backup review
source_system: ATS terms; file storage settings; email provider and partner documentation
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: No independent copy of ATS candidate and job order data; ATS platform backups not confirmed (SOC 2 report not requested); email provider backups documented; draft P01 and P05 files kept in the file storage with 30-day version history; the vendors encrypt backups and protect their integrity (security pages; partner SOC 2 report); every ATS backup sits with the ATS vendor, which deletes data 30 days after a subscription ends

title: Control assessment: Account monitoring self-review
source_system: Email sign-in history; mailbox forwarding rules; ATS activity log; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: The email sign-in history, mailbox forwarding rules and ATS export log have never been reviewed; new-sign-in alerts are off; no process exists to act on a review result or to review more often after a phishing attempt or a vendor notice

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting self-review
source_system: Contact lists; vendor terms; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-recruiter with the IT support technician
what_it_shows: No reporting time is defined; vendors have no duty in their terms to report incidents to the owner; there is no list of whom to notify (counsel, partner, clients, Florida Department of Legal Affairs); the owner did not know the Florida 30-day clock
